The introductory immediate-effect language and the specified 28 November 2025 commencement require reconciliation for actual relief. The text does not establish a universal implementation-date test. Node 4e6a162c35678e9ddf17ad8e should also clarify whether its question's proposed implementation date and its executable assessment date are the same event.

Missing additional authorities for actual procedural availability include the relevant updated SFC FAQs and any authoritative clarification of the transition and commencement provisions. Applicable home-jurisdiction requirements are also needed to establish home compliance for an actual change. The supplied missing dependency IDs have no identifying descriptions, so no catalogue mapping can be justified.

The introductory reference to home supervision does not clearly impose a separate item (ii) condition beyond home-requirements compliance. Retain that interpretive distinction rather than importing item (i)'s express supervision condition.
